mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2200 units, indicating strengthening demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market influence on consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 5% YoY signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window during tightening cycles, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO YoY growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a GDP (GDPC1) growth rate above 3% signals a strong economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP influence on stock markets
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises by more than 50 basis points in a quarter and CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth remains below 2%, the mixed monetary and inflation signals predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 50bps in a quarter and CPIAUCSL growth < 2%
evidence_refs: fact:historical influence of mixed monetary and inflation signals
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment (UNRATE) by more than 1 percentage point in 6 months, indicating a rapidly improving labor market, always predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market influence on stock markets
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE drops by > 1pp in 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show growth above 4% YoY, the combined supply and demand strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
evidence_refs: fact:historical influence of combined supply and demand on stock markets
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
